spectra.display_precision: Raw fixed-point squared magnitude cast to JS double for display only; all verification uses exact uint64.
spectra.time_scope: Input-window end times. Frame 0 has 128 leading zeros. Final flush frame ends 128 samples after the original clip.

metrics.byte_scope: Prefix through original duration, including one flush spectral frame. The separate 8-second transaction includes a zero tail.

audio.normalization: Fixed 8x integer conversion for every recording, threshold and audio mode. No independent normalization or clipping.

provenance.physical_timing_scope: Full padded 8-second finite transaction; service includes HPS PIO/feed/drain stalls. Host roundtrip also includes network. Neither is compute-only FPGA time.
provenance.playback_scope: Recorded physical FPGA results. This portable edition does not connect to or run a board. Playback and available stage traces replay completed captures. Time-synchronized playback after physical finite capture, not a live ADC or incremental FPGA stream.

cpu_timing.scope: Recorded on the original measurement laptop for this saved physical capture. These timings are not measured on the computer currently viewing this portable demo. Warm-RAM laptop per original clip. Spectral routes: strict packet decode + native features + complete causal monitor. CPU PCM route: FFT + same threshold + features + monitor, without IFFT or packet generation. Excludes physical FPGA producer, transport, file IO, audio, visual rendering and context construction. Short demo timing, not a formal benchmark.
cpu_timing.comparison: Processed dense and sparse contain identical values. Original dense changes both signal values and threshold; no whole-system FPGA speedup is inferred.
